subject: Pilot Wrap — latency & cost wins; quick reference ask
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@starlily.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot Wrap — latency & cost wins; quick reference ask

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. We pulled together the final numbers and wanted to share the headline outcomes before we set up a short wrap call: 

- P95 generation latency: 420ms -> 245ms (42% reduction)
- Average cost per request: $0.053 -> $0.033 (37% reduction)
- Throughput at target SLAs: sustained 3x increase for parallel workloads
- Token-level error rate: 1.8% -> 0.4%

I attached the starlily-poc-metrics.xlsx with the per-test breakdown and the Redwood one-pager. Would you be open to a 10–15 minute call this week to capture a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in a short case snippet? If you prefer, a one-liner in an email works fine too.

Suggested asks for the call: quick permission to publish (1–2 lines), preferred attribution (job title/company), and any guardrails (phrasing or metrics you don’t want published).

Next steps from our side: we can prepare a two-line draft and send it to you for approval before publishing.

Thanks — really appreciate how quickly your team ran the tests.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Atts: starlily-poc-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-onepager.pdf (PDF)

From: Julia Park <julia@starlily.ai>

Cc: Ahmed Raza <ahmed@starlily.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot Wrap — latency & cost wins; quick reference ask

Soojin —

Huge thanks for the summary and for the team's help running the POC. The numbers look right from our side; Ahmed and I validated the load tests this morning. Quick one-liner you can use if helpful: 

"Switching to Redwood reduced our generation latency and cut per-query costs substantially, enabling faster responses for customers without sacrificing quality."

Feel free to attribute that to me, Julia Park, Head of Product, Starlily AI. We're happy to do a quick 15-minute call if you want to capture a slightly longer quote, but the line above should work for the case snippet.

Also: please don’t publish the raw test traces — the summarized metrics are fine.

Best,
Julia
